tutorial.foundation: There are eight foundations, two per suit. They **start empty**: an Ace goes up when one appears, and each then builds A-K in suit, 13 cards. All eight -- 8 x 13 = 104 -- wins the game.
tutorial.tableau: Eight tableau piles, dealt **one card each** (the other 96 are the stock). Build down **ignoring suit and colour**, but **only one card moves at a time**.
tutorial.emptyPile: When a pile empties it can be refilled **only from the stock or the waste**. A tableau card can never move into a gap, so an empty pile is not a tool for rearranging the board -- it is an outlet for the stock.
tutorial.stock: Turn the stock one card at a time onto the waste. **There is no redeal -- one pass only.** When a pile is empty you can place straight from the stock without spending a turn on the waste.
tutorial.controls: Draw, hint, undo, auto-complete, and the other controls.
